# Vít Šebestík

> Personal website and portfolio of Vít Šebestík: developer and IT specialist at Librion, with a master's degree in computational linguistics from the Faculty of Arts, Masaryk University (2026). Works across frontend, backend and language processing.

The site is a single page. Sections: web projects, app projects, about, contact (a message form).

## Web projects

- [RustTools](https://www.rust-tools.eu/)
- [VAS Solutions s.r.o.](https://www.vas-solutions.cz/)
- [TJ Sokol Polanka](https://www.sokol-polanka.cz/)
- [MP celní služby](https://www.mpcelnisluzby.cz/)
- Also: Librion s.r.o., Wishlist App, Obrazy od Ameli

## App projects

- Audio Analysis Tool: software for analyzing audio corpora with automatic AI-based detection of lexical units.
- Subtitle Sentiment Analysis: bachelor's thesis in NLP, a script for cleaning subtitles and building a corpus for emotion analysis.
- OmniDesk: a desktop app for full PC management in one place, including bulk software installs via Winget after a clean Windows install.
- GLPI Agent Enhancement: an extension of the GLPI agent, a configurable script that scans an IP range in parallel, reports to GLPI and logs every run.

## About

- Role: Developer, IT Specialist at Librion
- Education: Master's degree (Mgr.), Computational Linguistics, Faculty of Arts, Masaryk University, 2026
- Works across: frontend, backend, language processing
- Approach: technical precision, analytical thinking, a sense of design
